Description (SPA): Clave normalizada de partido, coalicion, candidatura independiente u opcion electoral convertida desde columnas anchas de votos.
Description (ENG): Normalized key for a party, coalition, independent candidacy, or vote option converted from wide vote columns.
Values / Domain: Examples: PAN, PRI, PRD, APM, PBT, PAN_PRI_PRD, CAND_IND_1.
Notes: The key is a vote-option identifier, not always a legally independent party. Historical coalition labels reflect the source cycle.

Description (SPA): Indica si la opcion de voto representa una coalicion o combinacion de partidos.
Description (ENG): Indicates whether the vote option represents a coalition or party combination.
Values / Domain: 0/1 in SQLite; boolean in source parquet.
Notes: Computed during cleaning from source naming conventions and coalition membership.

Description (SPA): Lista o descripcion de integrantes de la coalicion cuando se puede determinar.
Description (ENG): List or description of coalition members when it can be determined.
Values / Domain: Text, delimited member list, or NULL.
Notes: For single parties this can be NULL or the single member depending on the clean script; use is_coalition to identify coalition options.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
